behaviors.description: List all exported document IDs and full original paths.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal with distinct exports, including a filename containing spaces.
behaviors.expected: Exact rows include both IDs and untruncated original paths with no duplicates or extras.

behaviors.description: Filter document exports by app ID.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal with distinct exports granted to two different apps.
behaviors.expected: Unfiltered listing has both documents; each app gets only its own row; unknown app gets no rows.

mappings.rationale: Exact tab-separated rows compare IDs returned by export with independent complete origin paths.
Two opposing app-filter controls and an unknown-app empty result reject an implementation that ignores APPID.
